scientific_integrity: Proof supplied for all dimensions at least two; exact-rational checker covers dimensions 2 through 7. Equivalent prior statements in unindexed sources cannot be excluded. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only calibrated complete directional profiles of full-dimensional ellipsoids; no noisy-function inversion or arbitrary convex-body reconstruction; finite-view criterion is universal, not pointwise-local necessity.
title: Sharp finite-direction determination of ellipsoids by complete parallel-section profiles
